scope: Admission bounds active entity readers and encoded-byte reservations only; it does not bound all HTTP workers, pre-header connections, decoded allocations, queued arguments, response writes or total process memory.
A client still uploading can observe a connection reset instead of a rejection response. Only an actually received explicit refusal proves non-acceptance for that attempt.

Mono chunk completion uses guarded reflection and a temporary raw-EOF observer restored in finally; unknown runtimes retain their native framing behavior. A changed known-Mono layout refuses chunked input with a Content-Length fallback hint.
Buffered MemoryStream timings are not network throughput. The allocation API failed its positive control; zero allocated-byte readings are unusable.
